verdict.rationale: The evidence pack says only that messaging exists in Dialpad's unified app and that inbound texts can be blocked company-wide. Nothing documents texts to a business number being routed into a shared team inbox, or showing which teammate replied. The axis clearly applies to a business phone and contact-center product, so the missing evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a support leader, texts to the business number land in a shared inbox where the team sees who replied
